Definition
[Topological hyperbolic piece] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0206 1. ch31:31.29\group Hyperbolic 3-manifolds

A compact submanifold of a closed 3-manifold whose boundary is a union of tori and whose interior carries a complete finite-volume hyperbolic metric is a topological hyperbolic piece.
